top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The first aid kit was missing tweezers.

top_violation_types.title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that an employee who left in October 2025 was not inactivated until February 2026.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Activities for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Outdoor Play (26 TAC §746.2607(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Observed that pre-kindergarten children are not engaged in outdoor play for 90 minutes a day as weather permit.

top_violation_types.title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report (26 TAC §746.201(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During a DFPS investigation, it was found that the operation staff was notified of possible abuse against a child in care and the operation did not report to licensing.
